title: Jeremiah Trotter Jr., Bryan Thomas Jr. were ejected for "continuous, non-football actions"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jeremiah Trotter Jr., Bryan Thomas Jr. were ejected for "continuous, non-football actions"
sources.description: After the opening kickoff on Sunday morning's Eagles-Jaguars game in London (a play that was wiped out by offsetting penalties), Eagles linebacker Jeremiah Trotter Jr. and Jaguars defensive end Bryan Thomas Jr. were ejected.
